defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfill do
  @moduledoc """
  One-off backfill for journal entries that predate booking at posting time and
  are still missing a category or a need/want choice.

  An entry is completed only when the same user's posted entries from the same
  issuer (compared like the duplicate index, trimmed and case-insensitive) agree
  on every missing value. Values the entry already has are kept. Anything else
  is reported for a person to book, so nothing is guessed from a similar name.

  It is a dry run unless called with `confirm: true`. Each entry is updated in
  its own transaction together with a `journal_entry_booking_backfilled` event
  that records the prior state. Tax claims and notes are left alone, and
  `updated_at` is kept so old entries do not jump to the top of the journal.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias Ecto.Multi
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision

  @event_type "journal_entry_booking_backfilled"

  @type match :: %{
          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
          document_id: integer(),
          category: String.t(),
          need_or_want: String.t(),
          precedent_count: pos_integer()
        }

  @type unmatched :: %{
          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
          document_id: integer(),
          reason: :no_history | :conflicting_history
        }

  @type summary :: %{
          confirmed: boolean(),
          matched: [match()],
          applied: [match()],
          unmatched: [unmatched()],
          failed: [%{match: match(), errors: term()}]
        }

  @doc """
  Plans the backfill and, with `confirm: true`, applies it.

  Returns `{:error, summary}` only when an update failed. Unmatched entries are
  expected and left for manual booking.
  """
  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
  def run(opts \\ []) do
    confirmed = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false)
    %{matched: matched, unmatched: unmatched} = plan()
    %{applied: applied, failed: failed} = apply_matches(matched, confirmed)

    summary = %{
      confirmed: confirmed,
      matched: matched,
      applied: applied,
      unmatched: unmatched,
      failed: failed
    }

    {if(failed == [], do: :ok, else: :error), summary}
  end

  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
  def format_summary(summary) do
    verb = if summary.confirmed, do: "Booked", else: "Would book"
    mode = if summary.confirmed, do: "applied", else: "dry run"

    [
      "Legacy booking backfill (#{mode}): matched=#{length(summary.matched)} " <>
        "applied=#{length(summary.applied)} unmatched=#{length(summary.unmatched)} " <>
        "failed=#{length(summary.failed)}",
      Enum.map(summary.matched, &format_match(&1, verb)),
      Enum.map(summary.unmatched, &format_unmatched/1),
      Enum.map(summary.failed, &format_failure/1),
      if(summary.confirmed, do: [], else: "Nothing changed. Re-run with confirm: true to apply.")
    ]
    |> List.flatten()
    |> Enum.join("\n")
  end

  defp plan do
    precedents = precedents()

    targets()
    |> Enum.map(&classify(&1, precedents))
    |> Enum.group_by(&elem(&1, 0), &elem(&1, 1))
    |> then(&%{matched: Map.get(&1, :matched, []), unmatched: Map.get(&1, :unmatched, [])})
  end

  defp targets do
    Repo.all(
      from e in JournalEntry,
        join: d in ReviewDecision,
        on: d.id == e.review_decision_id,
        join: c in ExtractedContent,
        on: c.id == d.extracted_content_id,
        where: is_nil(e.category) or is_nil(e.need_or_want),
        order_by: e.id,
        select: %{
          entry: e,
          document_id: c.document_id,
          issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer)
        }
    )
  end

  defp precedents do
    from(e in JournalEntry,
      where: e.status == "posted",
      where: not is_nil(e.category) and not is_nil(e.need_or_want),
      where: fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", e.issuer),
      group_by: [e.user_id, fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer), e.category, e.need_or_want],
      select: %{
        user_id: e.user_id,
        issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer),
        category: e.category,
        need_or_want: e.need_or_want,
        count: count(e.id)
      }
    )
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.group_by(&{&1.user_id, &1.issuer_key})
  end

  defp classify(%{entry: entry, document_id: document_id, issuer_key: issuer_key}, precedents) do
    history = Map.get(precedents, {entry.user_id, issuer_key}, [])
    row = %{entry: entry, document_id: document_id}

    case history |> Enum.map(&completed_booking(entry, &1)) |> Enum.uniq() do
      [] ->
        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :no_history)}

      [{category, need_or_want}] ->
        precedent_count = history |> Enum.map(& &1.count) |> Enum.sum()

        {:matched,
         Map.merge(row, %{
           category: category,
           need_or_want: need_or_want,
           precedent_count: precedent_count
         })}

      _conflicting ->
        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :conflicting_history)}
    end
  end

  # Precedents only need to agree on what the entry is missing.
  defp completed_booking(entry, precedent) do
    {entry.category || precedent.category, entry.need_or_want || precedent.need_or_want}
  end

  defp apply_matches(_matched, false), do: %{applied: [], failed: []}

  defp apply_matches(matched, true) do
    results = Enum.map(matched, &{&1, apply_match(&1)})

    %{
      applied: for({match, {:ok, _}} <- results, do: match),
      failed:
        for({match, {:error, _step, changeset, _}} <- results) do
          %{match: match, errors: changeset.errors}
        end
    }
  end

  defp apply_match(match) do
    Multi.new()
    |> Multi.update(:entry, booking_changeset(match))
    |> Multi.insert(:event, event_changeset(match))
    |> Repo.transaction()
  end

  defp booking_changeset(%{entry: entry} = match) do
    entry
    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(%{
      category: match.category,
      need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
      status: "posted"
    })
    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
  end

  defp event_changeset(%{entry: entry} = match) do
    EventLog.changeset_for_create(%{
      event_type: @event_type,
      invoice_id: to_string(entry.id),
      user_id: entry.user_id,
      status: "completed",
      metadata: %{
        category: match.category,
        need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
        precedent_count: match.precedent_count,
        previous_status: entry.status,
        previous_category: entry.category,
        previous_need_or_want: entry.need_or_want
      }
    })
  end

  defp format_match(%{entry: entry} = match, verb) do
    "#{verb} entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) as #{match.category} / #{match.need_or_want} " <>
      "from #{match.precedent_count} earlier posting(s)."
  end

  defp format_unmatched(%{entry: entry, document_id: document_id, reason: reason}) do
    "Book by hand: entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) at /documents/#{document_id}: " <>
      unmatched_reason(reason) <> "."
  end

  defp unmatched_reason(:no_history), do: "no earlier posting from this issuer"
  defp unmatched_reason(:conflicting_history), do: "earlier postings disagree"

  defp format_failure(%{match: %{entry: entry}, errors: errors}) do
    "Failed entry #{entry.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfillTest do
  use ZaimuTomo.DataCase, async: true

  import ZaimuTomo.AccountsFixtures, only: [user_fixture: 0, user_scope_fixture: 1]
  import ZaimuTomo.DocumentsFixtures
  import ZaimuTomo.ReviewFixtures, only: [extracted_content_fixture: 3]

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfill
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog

  @event_type "journal_entry_booking_backfilled"

  setup do
    user = user_fixture()
    %{user: user, scope: user_scope_fixture(user)}
  end

  test "a dry run reports the plan and changes nothing", %{scope: scope, user: user} do
    booked(scope, user, "Swisscom", "Utilities", "need")
    entry = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Swisscom")

    assert {:ok, summary} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run()

    assert [%{category: "Utilities", need_or_want: "need", precedent_count: 1}] = summary.matched
    assert summary.applied == []
    assert Repo.reload!(entry).status == "uncategorized"
    assert backfill_events() == []

    report = LegacyBookingBackfill.format_summary(summary)
    assert report =~ "dry run"
    assert report =~ "Would book entry #{entry.id} (Swisscom) as Utilities / need"
  end

  test "confirm books an uncategorized entry from a matching issuer and is repeatable", %{
    scope: scope,
    user: user
  } do
    booked(scope, user, "  SWISSCOM ", "Utilities", "need")
    booked(scope, user, "swisscom", "Utilities", "need")
    entry = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Swisscom", notes: "Keep me")
    last_edit = ~U[2026-03-02 08:00:00Z]
    Repo.update_all(from(je in JournalEntry, where: je.id == ^entry.id), set: [updated_at: last_edit])
    claims_before = Repo.aggregate(TaxDeductionClaim, :count)

    assert {:ok, summary} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run(confirm: true)
    assert [%{precedent_count: 2}] = summary.applied

    reloaded = Repo.reload!(entry)
    assert reloaded.category == "Utilities"
    assert reloaded.need_or_want == "need"
    assert reloaded.status == "posted"
    assert reloaded.notes == "Keep me"
    assert reloaded.updated_at == last_edit
    assert Repo.aggregate(TaxDeductionClaim, :count) == claims_before

    assert [event] = backfill_events()
    assert event.invoice_id == to_string(entry.id)
    assert event.user_id == user.id
    assert event.metadata["previous_status"] == "uncategorized"
    assert event.metadata["previous_need_or_want"] == nil

    assert {:ok, again} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run(confirm: true)
    assert again.matched == []
    assert length(backfill_events()) == 1
  end

  test "a posted entry keeps its category when precedents only agree on need or want", %{
    scope: scope,
    user: user
  } do
    booked(scope, user, "Mobility", "Transportation", "want")
    booked(scope, user, "Mobility", "Holidays", "want")
    entry = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Mobility")

    Repo.update_all(from(je in JournalEntry, where: je.id == ^entry.id),
      set: [category: "Software", status: "posted"]
    )

    assert {:ok, %{applied: [_]}} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run(confirm: true)

    reloaded = Repo.reload!(entry)
    assert reloaded.category == "Software"
    assert reloaded.need_or_want == "want"
  end

  test "leaves entries unchanged without a single agreed precedent", %{scope: scope, user: user} do
    booked(scope, user, "Split", "Transportation", "want")
    booked(scope, user, "Split", "Transportation", "need")
    conflicting = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Split")
    no_history = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Never Seen")

    other = user_fixture()
    booked(user_scope_fixture(other), other, "Other Users Issuer", "Software", "want")
    other_users_issuer = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Other Users Issuer")

    assert {:ok, summary} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run(confirm: true)
    assert summary.applied == []

    reasons = Map.new(summary.unmatched, &{&1.entry.id, &1.reason})
    assert reasons[conflicting.id] == :conflicting_history
    assert reasons[no_history.id] == :no_history
    assert reasons[other_users_issuer.id] == :no_history

    assert Repo.reload!(conflicting).status == "uncategorized"

    assert LegacyBookingBackfill.format_summary(summary) =~
             "Book by hand: entry #{no_history.id} (Never Seen) at /documents/"
  end

  defp backfill_events do
    Repo.all(from e in EventLog, where: e.event_type == @event_type)
  end

    {:ok, entry} =
      scope
      |> legacy_entry(user, issuer)
      |> Accounting.post_entry(user.id, category, need_or_want)

    entry
  end

  defp legacy_entry(scope, user, issuer, opts \\ []) do
    amount = System.unique_integer([:positive])
    document = document_fixture(scope, %{object_key: "documents/legacy-#{amount}.pdf"})

    content =
      extracted_content_fixture(document, user, %{
        extracted_data: %{
          amount_to_pay_cents: amount,
          invoice_date: "2026-03-01",
          invoice_number: nil,
          currency: "CHF",
          reason_for_payment: "Legacy",
          issuer: issuer
        }
      })

    {:ok, _} = Review.create_initial_decision(content)
    {:ok, decision} = Review.approve_invoice(content.id, user.id)
    {:ok, entry} = Accounting.get_journal_entry_for_decision(decision.id)

    Repo.update_all(from(je in JournalEntry, where: je.id == ^entry.id),
      set: [notes: Keyword.get(opts, :notes)]
    )

    Repo.get!(JournalEntry, entry.id)
  end
end

content.text:
The backfill script is written and `mix precommit` passes (551 tests, 0 failures), but it hasn't touched prod. It's uncommitted on `feat/unified-invoice-page` and needs a deploy before you can run it. I only read from prod, and the expected results below come from those queries.

**What it will do on prod's 6 incomplete entries**

| Entry | Issuer | Amount | Result | Based on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Anthropic, PBC | USD 21.62 | keeps Software, sets **Want** | 1 earlier posting |
| 2 | Swisscom | CHF 97.60 | keeps Utilities, sets **Need** | 1 earlier posting |
| 3 | Railway | USD 5.00 | keeps Software, sets **Want** | 2 earlier postings |
| 31 | Swisscom | CHF 177.60 | **Utilities / Need**, becomes posted | 1 earlier posting |
| 4 | Schweizerische Bundesbahnen | CHF 190.00 | left for you, at `/documents/10` | no exact issuer match |
| 29 | Hello Interview | USD 32.20 | left for you, at `/documents/40` | no history |

Entry 4 (Half Fare Travelcard) is clearly Transportation, but the near matches disagree on Need/Want: "SBB CFF FFS" is Want twice, while "Swiss Pass® (SBB CFF FFS)" is Need once. That's why the script only copies from an exact issuer match where all earlier postings agree.

Entries 1–3 were already posted without a Need/Want, so I included them too; the same gap affects them. Entries 31, 4 and 29 will start counting in the posted spending totals for their dates once booked.

**To run it**
```
kamal deploy
kamal app exec "bin/zaimu_tomo eval 'ZaimuTomo.Release.backfill_legacy_bookings!()'"
kamal app exec "bin/zaimu_tomo eval 'ZaimuTomo.Release.backfill_legacy_bookings!(confirm: true)'"
```
The first `eval` is a dry run that prints the plan; the second applies it. Then book entries 4 and 29 on their invoice pages. I made this a release task rather than an Ecto migration so ledger changes get a dry run and don't apply automatically on deploy.

**How it changes the ledger**
- **Audit trail:** each row gets a `journal_entry_booking_backfilled` event with its previous values, so automated choices stay distinct from yours and can be undone.
- **Left alone:** tax claims, notes and `updated_at` don't change. 26 posted entries already have no tax claim, so a missing one is normal, and old entries won't jump to the top of the journal.
- **Needs action tab:** I didn't change it, because once these are booked no incomplete entries remain.

The code is in `lib/zaimu_tomo/accounting/legacy_booking_backfill.ex`, and the runbook is in `docs/operations.md`.

`mix deps.get` warned about security advisories in some packages. `mix.lock` didn't change and I haven't looked into them.

Should I commit this and go ahead with fixes 1–5 from the review?

  its own transaction together with a `journal_entry_booking_backfilled` event
  that records the prior state. Tax claims and notes are left alone, and
  `updated_at` is kept so old entries do not jump to the top of the journal.

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry

  @event_type "journal_entry_booking_backfilled"

  @type match :: %{
          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
          document_id: integer(),
          category: String.t(),
          need_or_want: String.t(),
          precedent_count: pos_integer()
        }

  @type unmatched :: %{
          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
          document_id: integer(),
          reason: :no_history | :conflicting_history
        }

  @type summary :: %{
          confirmed: boolean(),
          matched: [match()],
          applied: [match()],
          unmatched: [unmatched()],
          failed: [%{match: match(), errors: term()}]
        }

  Plans the backfill and, with `confirm: true`, applies it.

  Returns `{:error, summary}` only when an update failed. Unmatched entries are
  expected and left for manual booking.

    summary = %{
      confirmed: confirmed,
      matched: matched,
      applied: applied,
      unmatched: unmatched,
      failed: failed
    }

    {if(failed == [], do: :ok, else: :error), summary}
  end

  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
  def format_summary(summary) do
    verb = if summary.confirmed, do: "Booked", else: "Would book"
    mode = if summary.confirmed, do: "applied", else: "dry run"

    [
      "Legacy booking backfill (#{mode}): matched=#{length(summary.matched)} " <>
        "applied=#{length(summary.applied)} unmatched=#{length(summary.unmatched)} " <>
        "failed=#{length(summary.failed)}",
      Enum.map(summary.matched, &format_match(&1, verb)),
      Enum.map(summary.unmatched, &format_unmatched/1),
      Enum.map(summary.failed, &format_failure/1),
      if(summary.confirmed, do: [], else: "Nothing changed. Re-run with confirm: true to apply.")
    ]
    |> List.flatten()
    |> Enum.join("\n")

      group_by: [e.user_id, fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer), e.category, e.need_or_want],

        user_id: e.user_id,
        issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer),
        category: e.category,
        need_or_want: e.need_or_want,

    )

    |> Enum.group_by(&{&1.user_id, &1.issuer_key})
  end

  end

    EventLog.changeset_for_create(%{
      event_type: @event_type,

      metadata: %{
        category: match.category,
        need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
        precedent_count: match.precedent_count,

        previous_category: entry.category,
        previous_need_or_want: entry.need_or_want

  defp format_match(%{entry: entry} = match, verb) do
    "#{verb} entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) as #{match.category} / #{match.need_or_want} " <>
      "from #{match.precedent_count} earlier posting(s)."
  end

    "Book by hand: entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) at /documents/#{document_id}: " <>

  end

  defp format_failure(%{match: %{entry: entry}, errors: errors}) do
    "Failed entry #{entry.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
  end

  One-off backfill for journal entries that predate booking at posting time and
  are still missing a category or a need/want choice.

  An entry is completed only when the same user's posted entries from the same
  issuer (compared like the duplicate index, trimmed and case-insensitive) agree
  on every missing value. Values the entry already has are kept. Anything else
  is reported for a person to book, so nothing is guessed from a similar name.

  Bookings a person already decided are listed in `@manual_bookings`, keyed by
  entry ID and normalized issuer so they cannot land on another row. They go
  through `Accounting.post_entry/6`, exactly like the invoice page's Book form.

  It is a dry run unless called with `confirm: true`. Each entry is updated in
  its own transaction together with a `journal_entry_booking_backfilled` event
  that records the prior state. For those copied bookings, tax claims and notes
  are left alone, and `updated_at` is kept so old entries do not jump to the top
  of the journal.

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias Ecto.Multi
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision

  @manual_bookings %{
    {4, "schweizerische bundesbahnen"} => %{
      category: "Transportation",
      need_or_want: "need",
      tax_status: "undecided"

          optional(:precedent_count) => pos_integer(),
          optional(:tax_status) => String.t()
        }

          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
          document_id: integer(),
          reason: :no_history | :conflicting_history
        }

  @type summary :: %{
          confirmed: boolean(),
          matched: [match()],
          applied: [match()],
          unmatched: [unmatched()],
          failed: [%{match: match(), errors: term()}]
        }

  @doc """

  Returns `{:error, summary}` only when an update failed. Unmatched entries are
  expected and left for manual booking.

  Options:

    * `:confirm` - apply the plan instead of only reporting it.
    * `:manual` - decided bookings, defaulting to `@manual_bookings`.
  """
  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
  def run(opts \\ []) do
    confirmed = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false)
    %{matched: matched, unmatched: unmatched} = plan(Keyword.get(opts, :manual, @manual_bookings))
    %{applied: applied, failed: failed} = apply_matches(matched, confirmed)

    summary = %{
      confirmed: confirmed,
      matched: matched,
      applied: applied,
      unmatched: unmatched,
      failed: failed
    }

    {if(failed == [], do: :ok, else: :error), summary}
  end

  def format_summary(summary) do
    verb = if summary.confirmed, do: "Booked", else: "Would book"
    mode = if summary.confirmed, do: "applied", else: "dry run"

    [
      "Legacy booking backfill (#{mode}): matched=#{length(summary.matched)} " <>
        "applied=#{length(summary.applied)} unmatched=#{length(summary.unmatched)} " <>
        "failed=#{length(summary.failed)}",
      Enum.map(summary.matched, &format_match(&1, verb)),
      Enum.map(summary.unmatched, &format_unmatched/1),
      Enum.map(summary.failed, &format_failure/1),
      if(summary.confirmed, do: [], else: "Nothing changed. Re-run with confirm: true to apply.")

    |> List.flatten()
    |> Enum.join("\n")
  end

    precedents = precedents()

    targets()
    |> Enum.map(&classify(&1, precedents, manual))
    |> Enum.group_by(&elem(&1, 0), &elem(&1, 1))
    |> then(&%{matched: Map.get(&1, :matched, []), unmatched: Map.get(&1, :unmatched, [])})
  end

  defp targets do
    Repo.all(
      from e in JournalEntry,
        join: d in ReviewDecision,
        on: d.id == e.review_decision_id,
        join: c in ExtractedContent,
        on: c.id == d.extracted_content_id,
        where: is_nil(e.category) or is_nil(e.need_or_want),
        order_by: e.id,
        select: %{
          entry: e,
          document_id: c.document_id,
          issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer)
        }
    )
  end

  defp precedents do
    from(e in JournalEntry,
      where: e.status == "posted",
      where: not is_nil(e.category) and not is_nil(e.need_or_want),
      where: fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", e.issuer),
      group_by: [e.user_id, fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer), e.category, e.need_or_want],
      select: %{
        user_id: e.user_id,
        issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer),
        category: e.category,
        need_or_want: e.need_or_want,
        count: count(e.id)
      }
    )
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.group_by(&{&1.user_id, &1.issuer_key})
  end

  defp classify(%{entry: entry, issuer_key: issuer_key} = target, precedents, manual) do
    row = Map.take(target, [:entry, :document_id])

    case Map.fetch(manual, {entry.id, issuer_key}) do
      {:ok, decision} -> {:matched, row |> Map.merge(decision) |> Map.put(:source, :manual)}

  end

    case history |> Enum.map(&completed_booking(entry, &1)) |> Enum.uniq() do

        precedent_count = history |> Enum.map(& &1.count) |> Enum.sum()

        {:matched,
         Map.merge(row, %{
           category: category,
           need_or_want: need_or_want,
           precedent_count: precedent_count,
           source: :precedent

        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :conflicting_history)}
    end
  end

  # Precedents only need to agree on what the entry is missing.
  defp completed_booking(entry, precedent) do
    {entry.category || precedent.category, entry.need_or_want || precedent.need_or_want}
  end

  defp apply_matches(_matched, false), do: %{applied: [], failed: []}

  defp apply_matches(matched, true) do
    results = Enum.map(matched, &{&1, apply_match(&1)})

    %{
      applied: for({match, {:ok, _}} <- results, do: match),
      failed:
        for({match, {:error, _step, changeset, _}} <- results) do
          %{match: match, errors: changeset.errors}
        end
    }
  end

  defp apply_match(match) do
    Multi.new()
    |> Multi.update(:entry, booking_changeset(match))
    |> Multi.insert(:event, event_changeset(match))
    |> Repo.transaction()
  end

  defp booking_changeset(%{entry: entry} = match) do
    entry
    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(%{
      category: match.category,
      need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
      status: "posted"
    })
    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
  end

  defp event_changeset(%{entry: entry} = match) do
    EventLog.changeset_for_create(%{
      event_type: @event_type,
      invoice_id: to_string(entry.id),
      user_id: entry.user_id,
      status: "completed",
      metadata: %{
        category: match.category,
        need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
        precedent_count: match.precedent_count,
        previous_status: entry.status,
        previous_category: entry.category,
        previous_need_or_want: entry.need_or_want
      }
    })
  end

  defp format_match(%{entry: entry} = match, verb) do
    "#{verb} entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) as #{match.category} / #{match.need_or_want} " <>
      "from #{match.precedent_count} earlier posting(s)."
  end

  defp format_unmatched(%{entry: entry, document_id: document_id, reason: reason}) do
    "Book by hand: entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) at /documents/#{document_id}: " <>
      unmatched_reason(reason) <> "."
  end

  defp unmatched_reason(:conflicting_history), do: "earlier postings disagree"

  defp format_failure(%{match: %{entry: entry}, errors: errors}) do
    "Failed entry #{entry.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
  end

# Operations runbook

Day-2 tasks for the production deployment described in
[deployment.md](deployment.md). Commands assume the Kamal secrets are exported
(`set -a; source .kamal/secrets; set +a`).

## Quick reference

| Task | Command |
|---|---|
| Remote IEx console | `kamal console` |
| Run migrations | `kamal migrate` |
| Roll back one migration | `kamal db_rollback` |
| App logs | `kamal app logs -f` |
| Find stuck documents (dry run) | `kamal recover_stuck_documents` |
| Re-enqueue stuck documents | `kamal app exec "bin/zaimu_tomo eval 'ZaimuTomo.Release.recover_stuck_documents!(confirm: true)'"` |
| Verify every stored object exists | `kamal verify_storage` |
| Backfill document fingerprints | `kamal backfill_document_fingerprints` |
| Complete legacy bookings (dry run) | `kamal app exec "bin/zaimu_tomo eval 'ZaimuTomo.Release.backfill_legacy_bookings!()'"` |
| Complete legacy bookings (apply) | `kamal app exec "bin/zaimu_tomo eval 'ZaimuTomo.Release.backfill_legacy_bookings!(confirm: true)'"` |

Locally, the equivalents are `mix ecto.migrate`, `mix zaimu_tomo.recover_stuck_documents [--confirm]`, `mix zaimu_tomo.verify_storage`, and `mix zaimu_tomo.backfill_document_fingerprints [--confirm-reuse ID]...`.

## Document processing

### Watching jobs

OCR runs on the Oban `documents` queue and TypeSafe shadow runs on the `typesafe` queue.
There is no Oban Web UI. Inspect jobs from `kamal console`:

```elixir
import Ecto.Query
ZaimuTomo.Repo.all(from j in Oban.Job, where: j.state in ~w(available scheduled executing retryable),
  select: {j.id, j.queue, j.state, j.attempt, j.args})
```

Failed attempts are logged by `ZaimuTomo.ObanFailureLogger` as body-free
summaries. Terminal failures log `[OCR] Processing failed for document …`.
`oban_jobs.errors` holds the same bounded summaries, never OCR text.

### Stuck documents

A document is *stuck* when it has no extraction row and no live OCR job (for
example, a job was discarded or cancelled without recording a failure). Users
can retry stuck and failed documents from the UI. To sweep them in bulk:

1. Dry run: `kamal recover_stuck_documents` lists the stuck documents per user.
2. Enqueue: `kamal app exec "bin/zaimu_tomo eval 'ZaimuTomo.Release.recover_stuck_documents!(confirm: true)'"`
   (inside the container, `CONFIRM=true bin/recover_stuck_documents` does the same). This is idempotent, because Oban uniqueness prevents a second live job per document.

### Document fingerprint backfill

Uploads record a SHA-256 of their exact bytes (`documents.content_sha256`), and
postings copy it to `journal_entries.source_document_sha256`. Rows created
before the `20261017120000` migration have no fingerprint until this one-off
backfill reads their objects. The unique index exists before it runs, so it is
safe while the app stays online; no upload or approval pause is needed.

1. Run `kamal backfill_document_fingerprints`. It hashes every document with a
   null digest through the storage facade, then copies digests to journal
   entries one row at a time, oldest posting first. The report lists IDs and
   counts only, never bytes or digests. It exits non-zero while coverage is
   incomplete.
2. Read the report:
   - **Missing object / read failure:** the digest stays null; that document and
     its entries have no exact-file protection. Restore the object if a backup
     has it (then rerun), otherwise record the partial coverage.
   - **Collision:** two historical postings of the same user have identical
     bytes. The later entry stays null and is named with the entry it collides
     with. Nothing is deleted or merged. Review both entries in the ledger:
     a genuine duplicate is corrected through the normal ledger process; a
     legitimate reuse (for example, the same QR-bill for two periods) is
     confirmed by a human.
3. To record a human-confirmed reuse, rerun with the later entry's ID:
   `kamal app exec "bin/backfill_document_fingerprints <journal_entry_id> ..."`
   (locally, `mix zaimu_tomo.backfill_document_fingerprints --confirm-reuse <id>`).
   The entry gets its digest and `source_file_reuse_confirmed` in one update. An
   ID that does not collide is reported as unused and left unchanged.
4. Rerun after any resolution until it reports complete coverage, or until the
   only remaining rows are documented missing objects.

This is the only permitted update of an existing entry's fingerprint. If a
database-level immutability trigger on `journal_entries` is ever added, run the
backfill first or allow this update explicitly.

### Throttling

If the LLM provider rate-limits, set a lower `OBAN_DOCUMENTS_CONCURRENCY` (default 2)
or `TYPESAFE_MAX_CONCURRENCY` under `env.clear` in `config/deploy.yml` and redeploy. Locally, set
`OBAN_DOCUMENTS_CONCURRENCY=1` with a single-NPU FastFlowLM backend.

## Backups and restore

Data lives in two places that must be backed up **together and in order**:
RustFS objects first, then the PostgreSQL dump. Objects are created before rows
are inserted, and rows are deleted before objects. So an object export that is
older than the DB dump can contain only harmless orphan objects, never missing
ones.

Nightly, while document writes are quiet:

1. Export the bucket through the S3 API with `rclone copy --checksum --immutable` to a **new date-stamped path** on off-host storage, then `rclone check --checksum`. Use an rclone S3 remote with `provider = Other` and `force_path_style = true`, a read-only credential, and the RustFS region. Don't snapshot RustFS's `/data` directory while it is live.
2. `pg_dump` the production database to off-host storage.
3. Run `kamal verify_storage`.

Restore (also used for periodic restore drills on a scratch environment):
restore the object export first, then the Postgres dump, then run `bin/verify_storage`.
It must report zero missing and zero failed.

Backup credentials and destinations are not kept in the repository.

## Legacy upload volume

Before August 2026, document bytes lived in `priv/uploads` on a Docker volume
(`zaimu_tomo_uploads`). The migration release copied them to RustFS with
`bin/migrate_to_s3` (HEAD first, upload only missing objects, never overwrite or
delete) and verified them with `bin/verify_storage`. The volume mount in
`config/deploy.yml` and the directory in the `Dockerfile` remain until a restore
check is recorded. After that, remove both in a cleanup release and update
[architecture.md §11](architecture.md#11-risks-and-technical-debt).

## Completing legacy bookings

Entries approved before booking became part of posting can still lack a category
or a need/want choice. This one-off copies the choice from the same user's posted
entries with the same issuer, but only when they all agree on the missing values.

1. Run the dry run from the quick reference and read each planned booking.
2. Run the apply command. Each row writes a `journal_entry_booking_backfilled`
   event holding its previous values. Tax claims and notes are not touched.
3. Book each entry listed under **Book by hand** on the invoice page it names.

A rerun only considers entries that are still incomplete. An uncategorized entry
that gets booked starts counting in the posted spending totals for its date.

## Database access

The Postgres accessory's host port listens only on loopback. Use an SSH tunnel
from the operator machine, or `kamal accessory exec db "psql -U zaimu_tomo zaimu_tomo_prod"`.

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfillTest do
  use ZaimuTomo.DataCase, async: true

  import ZaimuTomo.AccountsFixtures, only: [user_fixture: 0, user_scope_fixture: 1]
  import ZaimuTomo.DocumentsFixtures
  import ZaimuTomo.ReviewFixtures, only: [extracted_content_fixture: 3]

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfill
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog

  @event_type "journal_entry_booking_backfilled"

  setup do
    user = user_fixture()
    %{user: user, scope: user_scope_fixture(user)}
  end

  test "a dry run reports the plan and changes nothing", %{scope: scope, user: user} do
    booked(scope, user, "Swisscom", "Utilities", "need")
    entry = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Swisscom")

    assert {:ok, summary} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run()

    assert [%{category: "Utilities", need_or_want: "need", precedent_count: 1}] = summary.matched
    assert summary.applied == []
    assert Repo.reload!(entry).status == "uncategorized"
    assert backfill_events() == []

    report = LegacyBookingBackfill.format_summary(summary)
    assert report =~ "dry run"
    assert report =~ "Would book entry #{entry.id} (Swisscom) as Utilities / need"
  end

  test "confirm books an uncategorized entry from a matching issuer and is repeatable", %{
    scope: scope,
    user: user
  } do
    booked(scope, user, "  SWISSCOM ", "Utilities", "need")
    booked(scope, user, "swisscom", "Utilities", "need")
    entry = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Swisscom", notes: "Keep me")
    last_edit = ~U[2026-03-02 08:00:00Z]

    Repo.update_all(from(je in JournalEntry, where: je.id == ^entry.id),
      set: [updated_at: last_edit]
    )

    claims_before = Repo.aggregate(TaxDeductionClaim, :count)

    assert {:ok, summary} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run(confirm: true)
    assert [%{precedent_count: 2}] = summary.applied

    reloaded = Repo.reload!(entry)
    assert reloaded.category == "Utilities"
    assert reloaded.need_or_want == "need"
    assert reloaded.status == "posted"
    assert reloaded.notes == "Keep me"
    assert reloaded.updated_at == last_edit
    assert Repo.aggregate(TaxDeductionClaim, :count) == claims_before

    assert [event] = backfill_events()
    assert event.invoice_id == to_string(entry.id)
    assert event.user_id == user.id
    assert event.metadata["previous_status"] == "uncategorized"
    assert event.metadata["previous_need_or_want"] == nil

    assert {:ok, again} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run(confirm: true)
    assert again.matched == []
    assert length(backfill_events()) == 1
  end

  test "a posted entry keeps its category when precedents only agree on need or want", %{
    scope: scope,
    user: user

end end @doc """ Records user feedback about extraction quality on the Langfuse trace associated with the given extracted content. `value` is `1` for correct, `0` for incorrect. Returns `:ok` when the score was recorded (or Langfuse is not configured, in which case it is a no-op). """ def submit_extraction_feedback(extracted_content_id, user_id, value, comment \\ nil) do with {:ok, content} <- get_owned_extracted_content(extracted_content_id, user_id), true <- is_binary(content.trace_id) do Langfuse.create_user_score(content.trace_id, value, comment) else nil -> {:error, "Extracted content not found or not owned by user"} false -> {:error, "No Langfuse trace recorded for this extraction"} end end @doc """ Scores the extraction of an invoice that was just posted, in the background. Without an explicit `override` (`0` or `1`), the score is `1` when the invoice was posted as extracted and `0` when fields were corrected. The comment lists the corrected fields with their extracted and posted values; the reviewer's own comment is never sent. A no-op without a Langfuse trace. """ @spec score_posted_extraction(ExtractedContent.t(), [{atom(), term(), term()}], 0 | 1 | nil) :: :ok def score_posted_extraction(content, changes, override \\ nil) def score_posted_extraction(%ExtractedContent{trace_id: trace_id}, changes, override) when is_binary(trace_id) do value = override || if(changes == [], do: 1, else: 0) comment = if changes != [] do "Corrected before posting: " <> Enum.map_join(changes, "; ", fn {field, from, to} -> "#{field} #{inspect(from)} -> #{inspect(to)}" end) end Task.start(fn -> with {:error, reason} <- Langfuse.create_user_score(trace_id, value, comment) do Logger.warning("Failed to record extraction score: #{inspect(reason)}") end end) :ok end def score_posted_extraction(_content, _changes, _override), do: :ok # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Queries # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- @doc """ Runs `Accounting.duplicate_check/3` for a review decision against `data` (its effective data, or amended data not yet saved), using the source document's fingerprint loaded through the decision's own user scope. The fingerprint itself never leaves the server-side contexts. """ @spec duplicate_check(ReviewDecision.t(), ExtractedData.t()) :: Accounting.duplicate_check() def duplicate_check(%ReviewDecision{} = decision, %ExtractedData{} = data) do Accounting.duplicate_check(decision.user_id, data, source_document_sha256(Repo, decision)) end def list_review_decisions(user_id) do query = from rd in ReviewDecision, join: ec in ExtractedContent, on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id, where: ec.user_id == ^user_id, order_by: [desc: rd.review_status == "pending", desc: rd.inserted_at] Repo.all(query) end changed = for field <- @data_fields, data_values(%ExtractedData{} = data) do %{ "issuer" => data.issuer || "", "amount" => amount_string(data.amount_to_pay_cents), "currency" => data.currency || "", "invoice_date" => data.invoice_date || "", "invoice_number" => data.invoice_number || "", "reason_for_payment" => data.reason_for_payment || "" } end defp amount_string(nil), do: "" defp amount_string(cents) when is_integer(cents) do cents Usage: amp threads [options] [command]

Thread management commands. When no subcommand is provided, defaults to listing threads.

Commands:

  new            [alias: n] Create a new thread
  continue       [alias: c] Continue an existing thread
  list           [alias: l, ls] List all threads
  usage          Show usage information for a thread
  context        [alias: analyze-context] Analyze the current context for a thread
  visibility     [alias: v] Show or set default visibility for this repository
  search         [alias: find] Search threads
  color          Set a thread color
  label          Add labels to a thread
  share          [alias: s] Share a thread
    multiplayer  Turn multiplayer on or off
      on         Turn multiplayer on for the default duration (1 week)
      off        Turn multiplayer off
      ttl        Turn multiplayer on for a specific duration
  import         Import conversations from other coding agents as read-only Amp threads
    detect       Show which coding agents have conversations on this machine
    codex        Import Codex conversations from this machine
    claude       [alias: claude-code] Import Claude Code sessions from this machine
  rename         [alias: r] Rename a thread
  archive        Archive a thread
  delete         Delete a thread
  markdown       [alias: md] Render thread as markdown
  export         Export a thread as JSON
  raw            [alias: raw-thread] Export raw actor thread data as JSON

Options:

  --include-archived
      Include archived threads in the list
  --limit <number>
      Maximum number of threads to return
  --offset <number>
      Number of threads to skip

Usage: amp threads continue [options] [threads...]

Continue an existing thread by resuming the conversation. Each thread can be a thread URL or ID. By default, interactive mode shows a picker. Use --last to continue the last thread for this terminal and mode in this checkout, falling back to the last thread in this checkout. When multiple threads are given, all are resumed and the first is shown in the foreground.

Options:

  --last
      Continue the last thread in this checkout for the current mode, preferring this terminal
  --pick
      Pick a thread interactively from a list (DEPRECATED: picker is now the default)

Global options:

  --visibility <visibility>
      Set thread visibility (private, unlisted, workspace, group)
  -V, --version
      Print the version number and exit
  -v
      Alias for --version
  --settings-file <value>
      Custom settings file path (overrides the default location /home/alexis/.config/amp/settings.json)
  --log-level <value>
      Set log level (parent, children, category, sinks, parentSinks, filters, lowestLevel, contextLocalStorage)
  --log-file <value>
      Set log file location (overrides the default location /home/alexis/.cache/amp/logs/cli.log)
  --mcp-config <value>
      JSON configuration or file path for MCP servers to merge with existing settings
  -m, --mode <value>
      Set the agent mode (low, medium, high, ultra, or a plugin mode by key or label, case-insensitive) — controls the
      model, system prompt, and tool selection
  --features <value>
      Enable a thread feature (known: fast, Faster serving for supported models, billed at a premium; plaid, Ultrafast
      serving for GPT-6 Astra, billed at a steep premium; implies Fast on other models; pro, GPT-5.6 Pro mode (OpenAI
      API only, not supported by ChatGPT subscriptions))
  --fast
      Run new threads in Fast mode (faster serving for supported models, billed at a premium); alias for --features fast
  --executor <value>
      Run a new thread locally, in an orb, or on a runner (local, orb, runner:<id>)
  --runner-dir <value>
      With --executor runner:<id>, select one absolute directory served by the runner for the new thread. Defaults to

defmodule ZaimuTomo.ReviewTest do
  use ZaimuTomo.DataCase, async: false

  alias Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
  import ZaimuTomo.AccountsFixtures, only: [user_fixture: 0, user_scope_fixture: 1]

  import ZaimuTomo.DocumentsFixtures, only: [document_fixture: 1, document_fixture: 2]

  import ZaimuTomo.ReviewFixtures,
    only: [
      approved_review_fixture: 2,
      extracted_content_fixture: 2,
      extracted_content_fixture: 3,
      pending_review_fixture: 1
    ]

  setup do
    original_config = Application.get_env(:zaimu_tomo, :langfuse)
    Application.put_env(:zaimu_tomo, :langfuse, enabled: false, environment: "test")

    on_exit(fn ->
      if original_config do
        Application.put_env(:zaimu_tomo, :langfuse, original_config)
      else
        Application.delete_env(:zaimu_tomo, :langfuse)
      end
    end)
  end

  describe "submit_extraction_feedback/4" do
    test "returns an error when the extracted content does not belong to the user" do
      user = user_fixture()
      scope = user_scope_fixture(user)
      document = document_fixture(scope)
      content = extracted_content_fixture(document, user, %{trace_id: "trace-abc"})
      other_user = user_fixture()

      assert {:error, "Extracted content not found or not owned by user"} =
               Review.submit_extraction_feedback(content.id, other_user.id, 0, "wrong amount")
    end

    test "returns an error when no Langfuse trace was recorded for the extraction" do
      user = user_fixture()
      scope = user_scope_fixture(user)
      document = document_fixture(scope)
      content = extracted_content_fixture(document, user)

      assert {:error, "No Langfuse trace recorded for this extraction"} =
               Review.submit_extraction_feedback(content.id, user.id, 1)
    end

    test "records a score on the extraction's Langfuse trace" do
      user = user_fixture()
      scope = user_scope_fixture(user)
      document = document_fixture(scope)
      content = extracted_content_fixture(document, user, %{trace_id: "trace-abc"})
      parent = self()

      Application.put_env(:zaimu_tomo, :langfuse,
        enabled: true,
        environment: "test",
        score_sender: fn payload ->
          send(parent, {:score_payload, payload})
          {:ok, %{status: 200}}
        end
      )

      assert :ok =
               Review.submit_extraction_feedback(content.id, user.id, 0, "amount was wrong")

      assert_received {:score_payload, payload}
      assert payload.traceId == "trace-abc"
      assert payload.value == 0
      assert payload.comment == "amount was wrong"
    end
  end

  describe "pending_review_count/1" do
    test "counts only pending reviews owned by the scope" do
      user = user_fixture()
      scope = user_scope_fixture(user)

      pending_document = document_fixture(scope)
      pending_document |> extracted_content_fixture(user) |> pending_review_fixture()

      approved_document = document_fixture(scope)
      approved_document |> extracted_content_fixture(user) |> approved_review_fixture(user)

      other_user = user_fixture()
      other_scope = user_scope_fixture(other_user)
      other_document = document_fixture(other_scope)
      other_document |> extracted_content_fixture(other_user) |> pending_review_fixture()

      assert Review.pending_review_count(scope) == 1
    end
  end

  describe "reject_invoice/4" do
    test "requires and persists a rejection reason" do
      user = user_fixture()
      scope = user_scope_fixture(user)
      document = document_fixture(scope)
      extracted_content = extracted_content_fixture(document, user)
      {:ok, _} = Review.create_initial_decision(extracted_content)

      assert {:error, changeset} = Review.reject_invoice(extracted_content.id, user.id, "")
      assert %{rejection_reason: ["can't be blank"]} = errors_on(changeset)

      assert {:ok, decision} =
               Review.reject_invoice(extracted_content.id, user.id, "Duplicate invoice")

      assert decision.review_status == "rejected"
      assert decision.rejection_reason == "Duplicate invoice"
    end
  end

# The duplicate panel's confirmation buttons submit the invoice form with
  # `confirm` set to the verdict they confirm.
  defp confirm_invoice(live, verdict, params \\ %{}) do
    live
    |> form("#invoice-form", invoice: Map.merge(@booking, params))
    |> render_submit(%{"confirm" => verdict})
  end

  defp flash(live, key) do
    %{socket: %{assigns: %{flash: flash}}} = :sys.get_state(live.pid)
    Phoenix.Flash.get(flash, key)
  end

  defp entry_for(review) do
    {:ok, entry} = Accounting.get_journal_entry_for_decision(review.id)
    entry
  end

  defp capture_scores do
    parent = self()

    Application.put_env(:zaimu_tomo, :langfuse,
      enabled: true,
      environment: "test",
      score_sender: fn payload ->
        send(parent, {:score_payload, payload})
        {:ok, %{status: 200}}
      end
    )
  end

  describe "check and book" do
    test "posts an unchanged invoice already booked, with comment and tax treatment", %{
      conn: conn,
      scope: scope,
      user: user
    } do
      review =
        scope |> document_fixture() |> extracted_content_fixture(user) |> pending_review_fixture()

      {:ok, live, _html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))

      _html =
        submit_invoice(live, %{
          "comment" => "Checked against the PDF",
          "tax_treatment_status" => "candidate"
        })

      assert flash(live, :info) == "Invoice posted to the journal"
      assert has_element?(live, "#invoice-posted")
      assert has_element?(live, "#invoice-comment-display", "Checked against the PDF")
      assert has_element?(live, "#invoice-tax-treatment", "Potentially deductible")
      assert has_element?(live, "#open-journal-entry")

      assert %ReviewDecision{review_status: "approved", review_notes: "Checked against the PDF"} =
               Repo.get!(ReviewDecision, review.id)

      entry = review |> entry_for() |> Repo.preload(:tax_deduction_claim, force: true)
      assert entry.status == "posted"
      assert entry.category == "Office"
      assert entry.need_or_want == "need"
      assert entry.notes == "Checked against the PDF"
      assert entry.tax_deduction_claim.status == "candidate"
    end

    test "a corrected amount in major units amends the invoice and keeps the extracted value", %{
      conn: conn,
      scope: scope,
      user: user
    } do
      review =
        scope |> document_fixture() |> extracted_content_fixture(user) |> pending_review_fixture()

      {:ok, live, html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))

      # The fixture extracted EUR 42.00; the form shows it in major units.
      assert has_element?(live, ~s(#invoice-amount[value="42.00"]))
      refute html =~ "Extracted <s>"

      assert render_change(live, "validate", %{"invoice" => %{"amount" => "39.90"}}) =~
               "1 corrected"

      submit_invoice(live, %{"amount" => "39.90", "comment" => "Discount on the PDF"})

      assert Repo.get!(ReviewDecision, review.id).review_status == "amended"
      assert entry_for(review).amount_cents == 3990

      # Posted: the corrected value with the extracted one struck through, and
      # the correction in the history.
      assert has_element?(live, "#invoice-posted s", "42.00")
      assert has_element?(live, "#invoice-history", "Amount corrected: 42.00 → 39.90")
    end

    test "undo restores the extracted value", %{conn: conn, scope: scope, user: user} do
      review =
        scope |> document_fixture() |> extracted_content_fixture(user) |> pending_review_fixture()

      {:ok, live, _html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))

      render_change(live, "validate", %{"invoice" => %{"issuer" => "ACME Corporation"}})
      assert has_element?(live, ".invoice-field.corrected #invoice-issuer")

      live |> element(".invoice-was button", "Undo") |> render_click()
      assert has_element?(live, ~s(#invoice-issuer[value="ACME Corp"]))
      refute has_element?(live, ".invoice-field.corrected")
    end

    test "a booking error posts nothing and leaves the invoice to check", %{
      conn: conn,
      scope: scope,
      user: user
    } do
      review =
        scope |> document_fixture() |> extracted_content_fixture(user) |> pending_review_fixture()

      {:ok, live, _html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))

      submit_invoice(live, %{"category" => "", "amount" => "39.90"})

      assert flash(live, :error) =~ "Could not post this invoice: category can't be blank"
      assert has_element?(live, "#invoice-form")
      assert Repo.get!(ReviewDecision, review.id).review_status == "pending"
      assert Accounting.get_journal_entry_for_decision(review.id) == :error
    end

    test "an unparseable amount is refused before anything is posted", %{
      conn: conn,
      scope: scope,
      user: user
    } do
      review =
        scope |> document_fixture() |> extracted_content_fixture(user) |> pending_review_fixture()

      {:ok, live, _html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))

      assert submit_invoice(live, %{"amount" => "12,50 CHF"}) =~ "Enter an amount like 89.90"
      assert Repo.get!(ReviewDecision, review.id).review_status == "pending"
    end

    test "an invoice approved before booking was merged can still be booked", %{
      conn: conn,
      scope: scope,
      user: user
    } do
      review =
        scope
        |> document_fixture()
        |> extracted_content_fixture(user)
        |> approved_review_fixture(user)

      assert entry_for(review).status == "uncategorized"

      {:ok, live, _html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))
      assert has_element?(live, "#invoice-booking-form")

      live
      |> form("#invoice-booking-form",
        invoice: Map.put(@booking, "tax_treatment_status", "not_deductible")
      )
      |> render_submit()

      entry = review |> entry_for() |> Repo.preload(:tax_deduction_claim, force: true)
      assert entry.status == "posted"
      assert entry.tax_deduction_claim.status == "not_deductible"
      assert has_element?(live, "#invoice-tax-treatment", "Not deductible")
    end

    test "rejecting asks for a reason and keeps the invoice findable", %{
      conn: conn,
      scope: scope,
      user: user
    } do
      review =
        scope |> document_fixture() |> extracted_content_fixture(user) |> pending_review_fixture()

      {:ok, live, _html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))

      assert live |> element("button", "Reject") |> render_click() =~
               "Why are you rejecting this invoice?"

      assert live
             |> form("#rejection_form", review_decision: %{rejection_reason: ""})
             |> render_submit() =~ "can't be blank"

      live
      |> form("#rejection_form", review_decision: %{rejection_reason: "Paid by my employer"})
      |> render_submit()

      assert has_element?(live, "#invoice-rejected", "Paid by my employer")
      assert Repo.get!(ReviewDecision, review.id).review_status == "rejected"
    end
  end

  describe "extraction feedback" do
    test "posting unchanged data scores the extraction as correct", %{
      conn: conn,
      scope: scope,
      user: user
    } do
      capture_scores()

      review =
        scope
        |> document_fixture()
        |> extracted_content_fixture(user, %{trace_id: "trace-ok"})
        |> pending_review_fixture()

      {:ok, live, _html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))
      assert has_element?(live, "#extraction-feedback")
      submit_invoice(live, %{"comment" => "private note"})

      assert_receive {:score_payload, %{traceId: "trace-ok", value: 1} = payload}
      refute Map.has_key?(payload, :comment)
    end

    test "corrections score the extraction as incorrect and list the fields, not the comment",
         %{conn: conn, scope: scope, user: user} do
      capture_scores()

      review =
        scope
        |> document_fixture()
        |> extracted_content_fixture(user, %{trace_id: "trace-fix"})
        |> pending_review_fixture()

      {:ok, live, _html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))
      submit_invoice(live, %{"amount" => "39.90", "comment" => "private note"})

      assert_receive {:score_payload, %{traceId: "trace-fix", value: 0, comment: comment}}
      assert comment =~ "amount_to_pay_cents 4200 -> 3990"
      refute comment =~ "private note"
    end

    test "an explicit choice overrides the automatic score", %{
      conn: conn,
      scope: scope,
      user: user
    } do
      capture_scores()

      review =
        scope
        |> document_fixture()
        |> extracted_content_fixture(user, %{trace_id: "trace-override"})
        |> pending_review_fixture()

      {:ok, live, _html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))
      live |> element("#extraction-feedback button", "Correct") |> render_click()
      submit_invoice(live, %{"amount" => "39.90"})

      assert_receive {:score_payload, %{traceId: "trace-override", value: 1}}
    end

    test "is hidden without a Langfuse trace", %{conn: conn, scope: scope, user: user} do
      review =
        scope |> document_fixture() |> extracted_content_fixture(user) |> pending_review_fixture()

      {:ok, live, _html} = live(conn, invoice_path(review))
      refute has_element?(live, "#extraction-feedback")
    end
  end

  describe "page content" do
    test "renders amounts with their extracted currency", %{conn: conn, scope: scope, user: user} do

  test "a dry run reports the plan and changes nothing", %{scope: scope, user: user} do
    booked(scope, user, "Swisscom", "Utilities", "need")
    entry = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Swisscom")

    assert {:ok, summary} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run()

    assert [%{category: "Utilities", need_or_want: "need", precedent_count: 1}] = summary.matched
    assert summary.applied == []
    assert Repo.reload!(entry).status == "uncategorized"
    assert backfill_events() == []

    report = LegacyBookingBackfill.format_summary(summary)
    assert report =~ "dry run"
    assert report =~ "Would book entry #{entry.id} (Swisscom) as Utilities / need"
  end

  test "confirm books an uncategorized entry from a matching issuer and is repeatable", %{
    scope: scope,
    user: user
  } do
    booked(scope, user, "  SWISSCOM ", "Utilities", "need")
    booked(scope, user, "swisscom", "Utilities", "need")
    entry = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Swisscom", notes: "Keep me")
    last_edit = ~U[2026-03-02 08:00:00Z]

    Repo.update_all(from(je in JournalEntry, where: je.id == ^entry.id),
      set: [updated_at: last_edit]
    )

    claims_before = Repo.aggregate(TaxDeductionClaim, :count)

    assert {:ok, summary} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run(confirm: true)
    assert [%{precedent_count: 2}] = summary.applied

    reloaded = Repo.reload!(entry)
    assert reloaded.category == "Utilities"
    assert reloaded.need_or_want == "need"
    assert reloaded.status == "posted"
    assert reloaded.notes == "Keep me"
    assert reloaded.updated_at == last_edit
    assert Repo.aggregate(TaxDeductionClaim, :count) == claims_before

    assert [event] = backfill_events()
    assert event.invoice_id == to_string(entry.id)
    assert event.user_id == user.id
    assert event.metadata["previous_status"] == "uncategorized"
    assert event.metadata["previous_need_or_want"] == nil

    assert {:ok, again} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run(confirm: true)
    assert again.matched == []
    assert length(backfill_events()) == 1
  end

  test "a posted entry keeps its category when precedents only agree on need or want", %{
    scope: scope,
    user: user
  } do
    booked(scope, user, "Mobility", "Transportation", "want")
    booked(scope, user, "Mobility", "Holidays", "want")
    entry = legacy_entry(scope, user, "Mobility")

    Repo.update_all(from(je in JournalEntry, where: je.id == ^entry.id),
      set: [category: "Software", status: "posted"]
    )

    assert {:ok, %{applied: [_]}} = LegacyBookingBackfill.run(confirm: true)

def handle_event("post", %{"invoice" => params, "confirm" => verdict}, socket) do
    socket = assign_values(socket, params)

    case parsed_data(socket) do
      {:ok, data} ->
        duplicates = Review.duplicate_check(socket.assigns.review_decision, data)

        case {duplicates.verdict, verdict} do
          {:possible, "possible"} ->
            post(socket, [])

          {:file_reuse, "file_reuse"} ->

          {current, _} ->
            {:noreply,

             |> assign_duplicates(duplicates)
             |> assign(:duplicate_error, current != :none)
             |> put_flash(:error, Duplicates.refusal_message(current))}

        case duplicates.verdict do

    else
      false -> :error

            need_or_want: values["need_or_want"],
            notes: comment

  Records user feedback about extraction quality on the Langfuse trace
  associated with the given extracted content.

  `value` is `1` for correct, `0` for incorrect. Returns `:ok` when the score
  was recorded (or Langfuse is not configured, in which case it is a no-op).
  """
  def submit_extraction_feedback(extracted_content_id, user_id, value, comment \\ nil) do
    with {:ok, content} <- get_owned_extracted_content(extracted_content_id, user_id),
         true <- is_binary(content.trace_id) do
      Langfuse.create_user_score(content.trace_id, value, comment)

defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.Currency

  @primary_key false
  embedded_schema do
    field(:amount_to_pay_cents, :integer)
    field(:invoice_date, :string)
    field(:invoice_number, :string)
    field(:currency, :string)
    field(:reason_for_payment, :string)
    field(:issuer, :string)
  end

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  @required_fields [:amount_to_pay_cents, :invoice_date, :currency, :reason_for_payment, :issuer]
  @optional_fields [:invoice_number]

  def changeset(attrs) when is_map(attrs) do
    %__MODULE__{}
    |> cast(attrs, @required_fields ++ @optional_fields)
    |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:currency)
    |> validate_required(@required_fields)
  end

  def embedded_changeset(_struct, attrs) do
    if is_struct(attrs, __MODULE__) do
      Ecto.Changeset.change(attrs)
    else
      %__MODULE__{}
      |> cast(attrs, @required_fields ++ @optional_fields)
      |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:currency)
      |> validate_required(@required_fields)
    end
  end

  def fields, do: @required_fields ++ @optional_fields

  @doc """
  Lists the fields whose value differs between `from` and `to` as
  `{field, from_value, to_value}`, in `fields/0` order.
  """
  @spec changes(t(), t()) :: [{atom(), term(), term()}]
  def changes(%__MODULE__{} = from, %__MODULE__{} = to) do
    for field <- fields(),
        Map.get(from, field) != Map.get(to, field),
        do: {field, Map.get(from, field), Map.get(to, field)}
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfill do
  @moduledoc """
  One-off backfill for journal entries that predate booking at posting time and
  are still missing a category or a need/want choice.

  An entry is completed only when the same user's posted entries from the same
  issuer (compared like the duplicate index, trimmed and case-insensitive) agree
  on every missing value. Values the entry already has are kept. Anything else
  is reported for a person to book, so nothing is guessed from a similar name.

  Bookings a person already decided are listed in `@manual_bookings`, keyed by
  entry ID and normalized issuer so they cannot land on another row. They go
  through `Accounting.post_entry/6`, exactly like the invoice page's Book form.

  It is a dry run unless called with `confirm: true`. Each entry is updated in
  its own transaction together with a `journal_entry_booking_backfilled` event
  that records the prior state. For those copied bookings, tax claims and notes
  are left alone, and `updated_at` is kept so old entries do not jump to the top
  of the journal.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias Ecto.Multi
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision

  @event_type "journal_entry_booking_backfilled"

  @manual_bookings %{
    {4, "schweizerische bundesbahnen"} => %{
      category: "Transportation",
      need_or_want: "need",
      tax_status: "undecided"
    },
    {29, "hello interview"} => %{
      category: "Education",
      need_or_want: "need",
      tax_status: "candidate"
    }
  }

  @type match :: %{
          required(:entry) => JournalEntry.t(),
          required(:document_id) => integer(),
          required(:category) => String.t(),
          required(:need_or_want) => String.t(),
          required(:source) => :precedent | :manual,
          optional(:precedent_count) => pos_integer(),
          optional(:tax_status) => String.t()
        }

  @type unmatched :: %{
          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
          document_id: integer(),
          reason: :no_history | :conflicting_history
        }

  @type summary :: %{
          confirmed: boolean(),
          matched: [match()],
          applied: [match()],
          unmatched: [unmatched()],
          failed: [%{match: match(), errors: term()}]
        }

  @doc """
  Plans the backfill and, with `confirm: true`, applies it.

  Returns `{:error, summary}` only when an update failed. Unmatched entries are
  expected and left for manual booking.

  Options:

    * `:confirm` - apply the plan instead of only reporting it.
    * `:manual` - decided bookings, defaulting to `@manual_bookings`.
  """
  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
  def run(opts \\ []) do
    confirmed = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false)
    %{matched: matched, unmatched: unmatched} = plan(Keyword.get(opts, :manual, @manual_bookings))
    %{applied: applied, failed: failed} = apply_matches(matched, confirmed)

    summary = %{
      confirmed: confirmed,
      matched: matched,
      applied: applied,
      unmatched: unmatched,
      failed: failed
    }

    {if(failed == [], do: :ok, else: :error), summary}
  end

  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
  def format_summary(summary) do
    verb = if summary.confirmed, do: "Booked", else: "Would book"
    mode = if summary.confirmed, do: "applied", else: "dry run"

    [
      "Legacy booking backfill (#{mode}): matched=#{length(summary.matched)} " <>
        "applied=#{length(summary.applied)} unmatched=#{length(summary.unmatched)} " <>
        "failed=#{length(summary.failed)}",
      Enum.map(summary.matched, &format_match(&1, verb)),
      Enum.map(summary.unmatched, &format_unmatched/1),
      Enum.map(summary.failed, &format_failure/1),
      if(summary.confirmed, do: [], else: "Nothing changed. Re-run with confirm: true to apply.")
    ]
    |> List.flatten()
    |> Enum.join("\n")
  end

  defp plan(manual) do
    precedents = precedents()

    targets()
    |> Enum.map(&classify(&1, precedents, manual))
    |> Enum.group_by(&elem(&1, 0), &elem(&1, 1))
    |> then(&%{matched: Map.get(&1, :matched, []), unmatched: Map.get(&1, :unmatched, [])})
  end

  defp targets do
    Repo.all(
      from e in JournalEntry,
        join: d in ReviewDecision,
        on: d.id == e.review_decision_id,
        join: c in ExtractedContent,
        on: c.id == d.extracted_content_id,
        where: is_nil(e.category) or is_nil(e.need_or_want),
        order_by: e.id,
        select: %{
          entry: e,
          document_id: c.document_id,
          issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer)
        }
    )
  end

  defp precedents do
    from(e in JournalEntry,
      where: e.status == "posted",
      where: not is_nil(e.category) and not is_nil(e.need_or_want),
      where: fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", e.issuer),
      group_by: [e.user_id, fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer), e.category, e.need_or_want],
      select: %{
        user_id: e.user_id,
        issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer),
        category: e.category,
        need_or_want: e.need_or_want,
        count: count(e.id)
      }
    )
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.group_by(&{&1.user_id, &1.issuer_key})
  end

  defp classify(%{entry: entry, issuer_key: issuer_key} = target, precedents, manual) do
    row = Map.take(target, [:entry, :document_id])

    case Map.fetch(manual, {entry.id, issuer_key}) do
      {:ok, decision} -> {:matched, row |> Map.merge(decision) |> Map.put(:source, :manual)}
      :error -> classify_from_history(row, Map.get(precedents, {entry.user_id, issuer_key}, []))
    end
  end

  defp classify_from_history(%{entry: entry} = row, history) do
    case history |> Enum.map(&completed_booking(entry, &1)) |> Enum.uniq() do
      [] ->
        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :no_history)}

      [{category, need_or_want}] ->
        precedent_count = history |> Enum.map(& &1.count) |> Enum.sum()

        {:matched,
         Map.merge(row, %{
           category: category,
           need_or_want: need_or_want,
           precedent_count: precedent_count,
           source: :precedent
         })}

      _conflicting ->
        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :conflicting_history)}
    end
  end

  # Precedents only need to agree on what the entry is missing.
  defp completed_booking(entry, precedent) do
    {entry.category || precedent.category, entry.need_or_want || precedent.need_or_want}
  end

  defp apply_matches(_matched, false), do: %{applied: [], failed: []}

  defp apply_matches(matched, true) do
    results = Enum.map(matched, &{&1, apply_match(&1)})

    %{
      applied: for({match, {:ok, _}} <- results, do: match),
      failed:
        for({match, {:error, changeset}} <- results) do
          %{match: match, errors: changeset.errors}
        end
    }
  end

  defp apply_match(%{source: :manual, entry: entry} = match) do
    Accounting.post_entry(
      entry,
      entry.user_id,
      match.category,
      match.need_or_want,
      entry.notes,
      %{"status" => match.tax_status}
    )
  end

  defp apply_match(%{source: :precedent} = match) do
    Multi.new()
    |> Multi.update(:entry, booking_changeset(match))
    |> Multi.insert(:event, event_changeset(match))
    |> Repo.transaction()
    |> case do
      {:ok, changes} -> {:ok, changes}
      {:error, _step, changeset, _changes} -> {:error, changeset}
    end
  end

  defp booking_changeset(%{entry: entry} = match) do
    entry
    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(%{
      category: match.category,
      need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
      status: "posted"
    })
    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
  end

  defp event_changeset(%{entry: entry} = match) do
    EventLog.changeset_for_create(%{
      event_type: @event_type,
      invoice_id: to_string(entry.id),
      user_id: entry.user_id,
      status: "completed",
      metadata: %{
        category: match.category,
        need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
        precedent_count: match.precedent_count,
        previous_status: entry.status,
        previous_category: entry.category,
        previous_need_or_want: entry.need_or_want
      }
    })
  end

  defp format_match(%{entry: entry} = match, verb) do
    "#{verb} entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) as #{match.category} / #{match.need_or_want} " <>
      match_origin(match) <> "."
  end

  defp match_origin(%{source: :manual, tax_status: tax_status}),
    do: "from a manual decision, tax status #{tax_status}"

  defp match_origin(%{source: :precedent, precedent_count: count}),
    do: "from #{count} earlier posting(s)"

  defp format_unmatched(%{entry: entry, document_id: document_id, reason: reason}) do
    "Book by hand: entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) at /documents/#{document_id}: " <>
      unmatched_reason(reason) <> "."
  end

  defp unmatched_reason(:no_history), do: "no earlier posting from this issuer"
  defp unmatched_reason(:conflicting_history), do: "earlier postings disagree"

  defp format_failure(%{match: %{entry: entry}, errors: errors}) do
    "Failed entry #{entry.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
  end
end
